C-SEC-GATEWAY-TOOLS.IntentSummary: Use a locked local deployment toolchain before passing deployment credentials. Approval is the owner's instruction to implement the reviewed Markdown plan on 2026-11-11; the plan's corresponding task defines the detailed behavior and regression matrix.

T-001.Title: Use a locked local deployment toolchain before passing deployment credentials

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Wrangler and its dependency closure have a dedicated reviewed lockfile with integrity.
Missing or mismatched local CLI fails without installation; only its process receives Cloudflare credentials.
Existing exact-main admission, receipt and Worker behavior remain intact.
